title: A data file that lost its header beside a WAL of committed frames is opened as a new, empty database

package.logContains: REPRODUCED: the open of an empty data file beside a WAL of committed frames created a new, empty database and discarded every frame: 0 of 50 rows

latest.logContains: FIXED: an empty data file, or one whose header page or first sector is zeros, beside a WAL of committed frames: the open restored the header from the WAL with every one of the 50 rows
